get_current_robot_info: get the current robot info including robot ID, job ID, work unit stage, and operator ID from the orchestrator
set_current_robot_operator_id: set the current operator ID for a robot by calling the orchestrator with the robot ID and operator ID
update_robot_hardware_config: update the robot hardware configuration by merging a list of RobotHardwareComponent objects with the orchestrator server
disconnect_orchestrator_connection: disconnect the current robot info client from the orchestrator server by clearing the connection reference
test_current_robot_info_error_handling: test the current robot info client error handling for HTTP errors, empty components, and missing orchestrator connections
